leaves.title: Staff Leaves
leaves.infoBody: This page lets HR admins view, approve, reject, or cancel leave applications for all staff. Staff apply for leave themselves via My Leaves; HR admins can also apply on their behalf using the button above. If a staff member exhausts their leave balance, the excess days are automatically marked as Loss of Pay (LOP) and deducted from payroll. Use the month/year filter to view historical records.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.infoBody: Payroll is processed in two steps: 1. Generate Draft — computes gross pay, LOP deductions (based on approved leaves), PF, PT, and TDS for all staff for a given month. 2. Finalize — locks the payroll so no further changes can be made and makes salary slips available to staff. You can recalculate a draft run if attendance or leave data changes before finalizing. Once finalized, each staff member can download their salary slip from My Salary. LOP (Loss of Pay) days are automatically deducted from gross salary based on approved leave applications that exceeded the leave balance.

salary.title: Salary Configuration
salary.ctcInfoBody: Set the monthly gross salary for each staff member here. The system uses salary components (defined in the Components tab) to automatically calculate earnings (Basic, HRA, TA, etc.) and deductions (PF, PT, TDS). Each CTC record has an effective date, so you can track salary revisions over time. You can optionally override specific component amounts using the JSON overrides field (e.g. {example}).
salary.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, mobile or staff ID…
salary.compInfoBody: Salary components define how gross CTC is split into individual line items on salary slips. Earnings (Basic, HRA, TA, Special Allowance) add to take-home pay. Deductions (PF — Provident Fund, PT — Professional Tax, TDS) are subtracted. Click Seed Defaults to add standard Indian payroll components automatically. Components with % of Basic or % of Gross calculation are recomputed each payroll run.
salary.noComponents: No components. Click "Seed Defaults" to add standard components.

kiosk.title: Attendance Kiosk
kiosk.typeHint: Type your employee code then press the button. Your browser will prompt for fingerprint, face, or a nearby phone scan to confirm your identity.
kiosk.lookupToggle: Don't remember your employee code? Lookup by ID or mobile
kiosk.howIntro: This kiosk uses WebAuthn — the same passwordless standard used by banks and Google. No fingerprint images are ever stored.
kiosk.howSetup: One-time setup: HR registers your employee code to your device's biometric (Face ID / fingerprint). A cryptographic key pair is created inside your device's secure chip — the private key never leaves it.
kiosk.howDaily: Daily check-in: Enter your employee code → the server sends a one-time challenge locked to your specific credential → your device asks for your biometric to sign it → attendance is recorded.
kiosk.howSecurity: Security: Someone else typing your code cannot mark attendance — the challenge requires your private key on your device. Your phone can also act as the authenticator via Bluetooth / QR scan.
kiosk.howRegister: Haven't registered yet? Log in to the dashboard → My Attendance → Register Device for Kiosk.
kiosk.followPrompt: Please follow your browser's biometric prompt. If a QR code appears, scan it with your registered phone.

zones.title: Attendance Geo-Zones
zones.aboutBody1: Geo-zones define where staff are allowed to mark attendance. Trace your campus outline on the satellite map, or set a centre point and radius. Staff must be inside at least one active zone, and their phone must be precise enough to prove it — a check-in is only accepted when the whole GPS accuracy circle falls within the boundary, so a phone guessing from the network is never admitted.
zones.aboutBody2: Leave the edges some room. A phone accurate to ±20m must stand at least 20m inside the line, so a boundary drawn tight to the walls will turn people away who are genuinely on site. Tracing the real outline beats a circle on any campus that is not round — a circle inside a long, narrow plot covers only a fraction of the grounds.

staffAtt.title: Staff Attendance
staffAtt.aboutBody: View daily attendance records for all staff. Staff can mark attendance via the WebAuthn Kiosk (fingerprint/face at main entrance) or through Geo-Fence check-in from their mobile. Use Mark Manually to record or override attendance (e.g., for a field visit). Open a Bypass Window to temporarily allow PIN-based marking when biometric devices are offline. Configure the allowed campus geo-zones via Geo-Zones. The tallies under the date are also the filter: tap Not marked to list the staff who have no record for the day yet and mark them from there, or any other tally to see just those people. The Check-in and Check-out columns each show how that half was recorded, and name the admin when someone other than the staff member recorded it. A small Late badge on a check-in means that staff member arrived after the late cutoff — it is tracked separately from Status, which is now decided purely by hours worked (PRESENT / HALF_DAY / ABSENT). Use Settings to change the full/half-day hour thresholds and the late cutoff time.

staffAtt.settingsBody: These thresholds decide the day's status on every checkout: PRESENT at or above the full-day hours, HALF_DAY at or above the half-day hours, otherwise ABSENT (staff marked ON_LEAVE or HOLIDAY are never touched). The late cutoff only sets the Late badge on check-in — it never changes the day's status. Changes apply to future check-ins/checkouts only; existing records are not recomputed.
